notes.method: Curves, grid lines and eta/Ny lines were extracted from the vector paths of the catalog PDF (not from pixels); axes calibrated locally on labeled grid lines (max residual < 2 px). Quadratics: P[Pa] = a*Q^2 + b*Q + c, Q in thousand m3/h, Pv = full pressure.
notes.qRangeGraph: Actual extent of the bold n=const curve on the graph (thousand m3/h). The catalog table rounds ranges to 0.40-0.90 / 0.80-1.80; do not extrapolate the quadratic beyond qRangeGraph.
notes.etaSamples: Crossings of the n=const curve with the constant-efficiency lines (straight lines of slope 2 in log-log). eta label order matches lines sorted left to right by upper end.
notes.powerSamples: Ny arcs (blue) do not cross the n=const curves on these graphs, so kw is SHAFT power derived at each eta crossing: kw = Q*1000*P/(3.6e6*eta). Cross-check: this value is constant along every blue Ny arc; Ny(installed) = shaft power * K, K about 1.5 for Ny<=0.25 kW and about 1.3 for 0.55-0.75 kW.
notes.pdvAxis: Pdv = coeffC * Q_thousand^2, coeffC = geometric mean over the 6 labeled Pdv ticks (10,20,50,70,100,200 Pa); tick scatter about +-3%.
